*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`) against `main`.

*P1 — Overlapping contacts aren’t deduplicated by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` compares objects by reference, not `id`. Separate imports containing different objects with the same ID therefore retain both contacts, violating the documented “one per ID, first seen wins” behavior.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
// Actual: both contacts
// Expected: only the first
```

Track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each. Add regression tests for distinct objects sharing an ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`.

*Validation:* All 4 existing tests pass, but both targeted overlap checks fail. The current duplicate test only repeats the same object reference, so it misses this case.

No other findings. No files changed.
